page.overview:
Who is Garrison Commander Carp?

When Sun Wukong came to the Dragon Palace of the East Sea in search of a weapon, Ao Guang had Provincial Commander Bream and Garrison Commander Carp bring him a heavenly halberd capable of deflecting spells and weighing 7,200 pounds, but Sun Wukong found it too light.

Category:Gods Category:Males Category:Attendants of Ao Guang
